Assembly changes MUST be proved against a frozen baseline
The manifest is the command inventory's single authority, and every downstream surface is gated against it
Four commands are lifecycle hooks, never user-facing verbs
The pipeline's document shape lives in command bodies, never in document templates
Both command families are always present; the workflow choice only routes dispatch
Every command degrades rather than failing the host
The pipeline right-sizes itself automatically, and an unresolved size runs the full pipeline
Completion is an explicit terminal step with exactly one writer
The feature pointer is written under the exact key the capture calls read
Living-spec commands are opt-in, non-halting, and honest about what they did not examine
Projects extend commands at node boundaries, never by editing bodies
Commands direct capable providers to parallelize, while bookkeeping stays serialized
A command that injects a step into a numbered body MUST NOT restart the numbering
A step's branch points are declared as data beside its node order
The command inventory records what each command's run must produce
Completion accounts for every loaded capability — a delta or an explicit skip, never silence
Step boundaries are extension-stamped in order on every dispatch path
Task finishes are folded into the shared record one at a time, as they land
One command syncs every affected living spec from the current changes, uncommitted included
The prompting contract is held by a static gate, not by convention
The specify-time living-spec load is recorded deterministically, not by AI judgment
A simple-verdict run captures the same context a full run would, on the fast path
The tasks Polish phase validates the spec's Success Criteria in exactly one place
Optional instrumentation is delivered by re-rendering the bodies, never left dormant in them
The load steps read a living spec by requirement, and fall back to the whole file
Adoption and sync write the file markers, so nobody maintains them by hand
capture-runtime: Recording state MUST NOT be able to break the run it observes
The context file is append-only, crash-safe, and tolerant of fields it does not own
Lifecycle status moves forward only, and the terminal state has exactly one writer
Timing is stamped by a script, never hand-authored
Per-task progress is finish-only, contention-free, and folded idempotently
Derived artifacts have exactly one writer
An unresolvable pointer is named, not passed over
The spec a write lands on is resolved by a fixed precedence, and a conflict refuses rather than guesses
Additive capture composes; lifecycle modes are exclusive
Folding a feature spec's requirement deltas into a living spec is idempotent for every verb combination
A probe that cannot determine an answer MUST report "unknown", never the negative
A report MUST NOT claim success for work it did not do
Living-spec path resolution stops at a nested project boundary
Each product ships every module its own entry points reach
The configuration is the source of truth and the command bodies are built from it
A build is all-or-nothing
A built body reaches the assistant only once it is carried out to the agent's own copy
A hook is rendered at the node boundary it names
A build states what each run must produce, derived from the order it assembled
The pipeline's decision points are data, not prose in three places
A template is customized by section, and the stock copy is never edited
Writing one key back into the configuration preserves everything else byte for byte
A configuration too broken to read is repairable from the panel that reads it
The pipeline's structure is emitted here and drawn elsewhere
A step a project declared is a real step; only a typo is refused
The write lock is released once, after the publish, on whichever path ran
The fold routes each capability's requirements to its own spec
The drift detector offers an opt-in working-tree mode
Recording which living specs cover a change MUST be deterministic, not AI-judged
Completion accounts for every loaded capability — fold it, or record a reasoned skip
An unmatched MODIFIED requirement is promoted to ADDED, not dropped
Status resolution dispatches commands from the family the spec has been running
Every handled call records itself, including the ones that fail
A call count may shrink only when the record it produces stays identical
A capability relocation is transactional — a partial failure rolls back every applied move
A reader of a captured list MUST accept every form its writer stores
A configuration the reader cannot fully read is rejected whole, never applied in part
The health check MUST consult the unrecorded-calls marker before concluding a spec has no trace evidence
The health check MUST report an implement step that closed having executed nothing
A living-spec load is sliced by requirement, and a spec with no markers is read whole
Which requirements a run read is recorded beside which capabilities it loaded

FR-002.title: Report a requirement that carries no scenario

FR-003.title: Report a scenario missing its condition or its outcome, naming which is absent

FR-004.title: Report two requirements sharing one heading within a single capability, never across capabilities

FR-005.title: Report a delta block marked for a capability the registry does not list

FR-006.title: Report a delta entry modifying or removing a heading the target spec does not carry

FR-007.title: Report a file marker whose pattern matches nothing on disk

FR-008.title: Always exit successfully, whatever it finds and whatever state the project is in

FR-009.title: A machine-readable form carrying severity, code, path, line, and a one-line fix per finding

FR-010.title: Inert when living specs are not enabled for the project

FR-011.title: The fold runs the same check against a feature spec deltas before writing anything

FR-012.title: The fold refuses a capability delta on an error-level finding and names the finding

FR-013.title: The fold applies normally when only warning-level findings are reported

FR-014.title: A refusal for one capability never blocks another capability sound delta

FR-015.title: The editor runs the same checks on save and publishes findings at their lines

FR-016.title: Editor findings clear when the underlying problem is fixed

FR-017.title: The editor checks nothing for a non-spec file or a project with living specs off

FR-018.title: The fold refuses to empty a capability spec unless retirement is declared, naming it

FR-019.title: The registry accepts an optional per-capability retirement declaration

FR-020.title: Checks existing in two runtimes are held to one shared set of example specs

FR-021.title: Drift, sync, coverage, adoption and the requirement-level load behave exactly as today

context: area: speckit-extension/scripts (drift.py finding shape, living_spec_fold.py, resolve-spec-paths.py)
constraint: the on-disk spec format does not change; markers are additive
constraint: living-specs.yml keeps its shape and most-specific-first glob ordering
constraint: the validator never fails or slows a host command
constraint: the extension ships in isolation and cannot shell out to the scripts
intent: Make a living spec's shape checkable, so a fold can refuse to damage the record and an author sees a break while typing it.
expectations: Splitting the four largest capability specs through the registry (item 7)
Any change to the on-disk spec format
Feature specs beyond their existing delta sections

decisions.decision: Implement the checks twice, once per runtime, pinned to one shared fixture set with a guard that fails when only one side reads an example
decisions.why: The shipped extension cannot assume the spec-kit scripts are installed, and a save-path subprocess is a cost on every keystroke-to-disk; the same arrangement already caught a real divergence between the two requirement slicers in Wave 1
decisions.rejected: Shelling out to the script from the editor, which makes the feature conditional on an install the extension cannot see

decisions.decision: Severity is two values, error and warning, and only error refuses a fold
decisions.why: Severity answers exactly one question here — does this stop the write — and the split follows the damage: a delta naming a missing heading corrupts the record, a requirement with no scenario is untidy
decisions.rejected: A numeric scale, and per-project configurability that would make safety a project-by-project question

decisions.decision: The fold imports the validator in-process rather than running the command and parsing its output
decisions.why: A correctness gate must not be defeatable by a missing interpreter or a subprocess that failed for an unrelated reason and looks like no findings
decisions.rejected: Spawning the CLI and reading its JSON

decisions.decision: An unmatched touches pattern is a warning
decisions.why: A marker may describe a directory a change is about to create, and marker matching only ever narrows a load, so an unmatched pattern costs a run nothing
decisions.rejected: Error severity, which would refuse folds over a condition that is often correct

decisions.decision: The duplicate-heading check is scoped to one capability
decisions.why: The heading is the join key for fold-back, coverage ids and the requirement cards, and every one of those is already per capability
decisions.rejected: Repository-wide uniqueness, which would report a finding on almost every well-written repo

decisions.decision: Retirement is an optional retire key on the capability registry entry
decisions.why: It is a fact about the capability, visible to a reviewer reading that entry, and it survives the fold that empties the spec
decisions.rejected: A marker inside the spec file, which the emptying fold would delete exactly when it mattered, and a fold flag nobody is present to pass

decisions.decision: Every finding carries a short stable code alongside its sentence
decisions.why: A refusal names the finding and a person will search for what it means; a code also lets a script recognise the same finding after the wording is improved
decisions.rejected: Matching on the human sentence, which makes the wording unrewordable

plan.summary: Plan for a two-runtime shape check, an in-process fold refusal on error findings, save-time diagnostics, and a registry-declared retire guard.
plan.key_finding: The fold must import the validator rather than shell out to it — a correctness gate that can be defeated by a missing interpreter is not a gate.

tasks.summary: 41 tasks in 7 phases and 10 waves: shared fixtures, the two check runtimes, then the CLI, the fold refusal, save-time diagnostics, the retire guard, and a polish phase that folds this work back into three capabilities.

approach: Add a read-only shape check that reports six kinds of finding with a file, line, severity, stable code and one-line fix. Wire it into the two moments it pays: the fold imports it and refuses to write a capability whose deltas carry an error, and the editor publishes the same findings on save. A separate guard refuses a fold that would leave a capability with no requirements unless the registry declares it retired.

concerns.note: Task finishes were journaled in 9 batches rather than one per task, the largest stamping 7 inside a second. The per-task summaries and their order are trustworthy; the per-task timestamps are not. History is append-only, so this cannot be repaired for this run.

The validator found one real warning in this repository, a requirement in the workflows capability with no scenario. Left as found: fixing a spec to silence a report the same run introduced would make the report meaningless.

43 shorthand scenario fixtures in test_living_specs.py were rewritten as real WHEN/THEN pairs because the new check reads them as malformed. Every assertion in those tests is on headings and counts, none on bullets, so the rewrite changed no test intent.
